initializationContract: standard host intrinsics at module initialization; postimport mutations tested
fixture: scalar Nat inputs; sum=Nat.add(a,b); bounded tree depth=U32.mod(U32.from_nat(sum),4); useful nonscalar structural component with original G Nat.add call

cases.name: maximum-plus-zero
cases.expect: full value parity; original native callback order; actual scalar proof entry and component entry

cases.name: maximum-minus-one-plus-one
cases.expect: same maximum sum; full value parity and actual entry

cases.name: overflow
cases.expect: same Error name/message/order a Nat past the largest immediate 2^48-1; no completed traversal

cases.name: valid-after-overflow
cases.expect: proof closed after failure; later valid root activates independently

cases.name: postimport-Nat.add-binding
cases.expect: generic fallback, replacement callbacks equal, zero inherited worker entries

cases.name: postimport-Nat.add-code
cases.expect: generic fallback, changed code callbacks equal, zero inherited worker entries

cases.name: postimport-Nat.add-accessor
cases.expect: generic lookup getter counts/order equal; zero inherited worker entries

cases.name: postimport-Error-hook-overflow
cases.expect: Error observer sees regionProof null; public data-taking function with external proxy uses generic path with same result/field access order; outer error and subsequent valid activation equal

negativeAssertionRule: Error callback fresh independently guarded scalar root is allowed; do not require zero fresh scalar root entries
proofEntryRule: use emitted original public/root entry; do not manually regionProofOpen in controller to manufacture activation
preimportWitness: retained separately, outside established init contract; not included as supported-domain pass/fail
runtimePreservation: ordinary G Nat.add checkedNat callback retained; no direct/flat Nat arithmetic inline
